note: XVII M4: Seward young and clean-shaven (Midjourney gave him a beard).

people.seward: Dr John Seward, a doctor of about thirty, dark hair, bare clean-shaven face with no beard and no moustache

beats.text: Make the man seated at the desk a young doctor of about thirty: remove his beard and moustache entirely so his chin, jaw and upper lip are bare and clean-shaven, with full dark hair and a young face, painted in the same light and brushwork. Change nothing else.
